title: Phased exposure and compatibility matrix for hosted/dedicated/private deployments
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Build a unified, environment-aware phased-exposure system that supports canary rollouts, A/B experiments, shadow traffic (traffic mirroring), and deterministic auto-rollback across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments while respecting environment-specific constraints and configuration differences.

Background: Teams need to launch new model versions safely across different deployment modes. Hosted customers expect fast canaries and automated rollback; Dedicated customers require capacity reservation and tenant isolation controls; Private installations have constrained networking, no control-plane hooks, and stricter upgrade windows. Current rollout tooling diverges per environment: hosted uses fast traffic-splitting, dedicated has manual admission gates, private relies on operator-driven upgrades. This ticket scopes a compatibility layer + phased exposure orchestration with explicit constraint modeling so we can offer a single declarative rollout plan that adapts to each environment's capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Declare rollout plans as a single YAML schema and translate to environment-specific execution steps
Support canary exposures (fractional traffic), mirrored shadowing and parallel A/B allocations in Hosted and Dedicated; provide dry-run and operator-confirmed steps for Private
Safety guards: metric-based auto-rollback with configurable thresholds (latency, error-rate, quality delta) and programmable grace periods

Compatibility matrix generated per model-version that enumerates required runtime features (KV cache pinning, quantization variant availability, batch window requirements) and flags gaps per environment
Automated test harness that simulates constrained environments (network partitions, no-control-plane) and validates fallback behavior
Docs and runbook published: rollout playbook, private operator checklist, and security sign-off completed
tasks: Design YAML rollout manifest and translator (spec -> hosted/dedicated/private)
Implement runtime constraint detector that annotates model variants with capability tags
Add traffic mirroring plumbing and cost-quoting for hosted/dedicated (shadow traffic accounting)
Build metric gates: latency, p99 increase, token-error-rate, custom quality eval delta
Integrate auto-rollback actuator and emergency pause hook for operators
Create private deployment agent shim for offline environments (manual step executor + signed plan)
End-to-end tests and chaos scenarios (simulated GPU OOM, slow kv-cache)
